propositions: The packaged code-review guide (src/rebar/_guides/passing-code-review.md lines 112-114) contains stale documentation stating that coverage-gap blocks require a maintainer re-trigger, contradicting the now-available self-service recheck-review mechanism.

Contributors discovering the guide via 'rebar explain review' are misdirected to ping maintainers instead of using the self-service recheck-review comment to re-trigger LLM review after infrastructure issues clear.

The recheck-review self-service mechanism was deployed in Gerrit change 1243 and documented in docs/review-policy.md and CONTRIBUTING.md, but the packaged guide was not updated to reflect this capability.
The packaged code-review guide is the primary on-ramp for contributors and the single most discoverable surface, making its stale text actively harmful to contributor workflow.
